title: Hywind Scotland 浮式風電
summary: 以Hywind Scotland浮式風電公開案例，將風能、浮體、繫泊、海纜與年能量各自建模，再檢查耦合效應與資料需求。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Hywind Scotland to model wind energy, floater, mooring, cable and annual energy separately before examining coupling and data requirements. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 標記固定Cp立方律的區間：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mark the fixed-Cp cubic-law range: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 標記固定Cp立方律的區間 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mark the fixed-Cp cubic-law range and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 標記固定Cp立方律的區間：風穿過面積的動能通量與風速三次方成正比；可取出功率受轉子效率與控制限制。 本步以「風能通量與額定外推」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the fixed-Cp cubic-law range: Wind kinetic-energy flux through an area scales with speed cubed; extracted power is constrained by rotor efficiency and controls. Use Wind-energy flux and rated-power extrapolation to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Hywind Scotland 浮式風電實際規格：ρair=1.225 kg/m³、A=1000 m²、風速v=8 m/s、假設Cp=0.4。式 P=ρAv³Cp/2，基準結果 125.44 kW。條件：固定Cp的教學區間，未含切入、額定限功率、切出與浮體運動。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Hywind Scotland floating wind project: ρair=1.225 kg/m³, A=1000 m², wind speed v=8 m/s, assumed Cp=0.4. Formula P=ρAv³Cp/2 gives 125.44 kW. Conditions: Teaching range with fixed Cp, excluding cut-in, rated limiting, cut-out and floater motion.
steps.failure: 將立方律外推到所有風速會高估年能量；需要風速分布與功率曲線。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Extrapolating the cubic law to all winds overestimates annual energy; a wind distribution and power curve are needed. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 把理論曲線與假設額定平台畫在同圖，指出立方律只在特定區間成立。 本案例另須檢查「標記固定Cp立方律的區間」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Plot the theoretical curve beside a hypothetical rated plateau and identify where cubic scaling is applicable. Also check that Mark the fixed-Cp cubic-law range and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：標記固定Cp立方律的區間。在浮式風機方塊圖、風速資料、繫泊與海纜示意完成資料或紙面模型練習。只提高假設風速10%，比較33.1%理論增幅，再標註額定限制可能使之失效。 算式區的基準值為125.44，改變後為166.96064 kW。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Mark the fixed-Cp cubic-law range. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Floating-turbine block diagram, wind records, mooring and cable schematics. Raise wind speed alone by 10%, compare a 33.1% theoretical increase and flag possible rated-power limits. Baseline 125.44 changes to 166.96064 kW. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Hywind Scotland 浮式風電」的「標記固定Cp立方律的區間：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Mark the fixed-Cp cubic-law range: Mechanism and observation” in “Hywind Scotland floating wind project”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：區分容量因數與機械效率。在浮式風機方塊圖、風速資料、繫泊與海纜示意完成資料或紙面模型練習。只提高額定功率10%，保持假設容量因數，重算年能量。 算式區的基準值為23652，改變後為26017.2 MWh/year。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate capacity factor and mechanical efficiency. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Floating-turbine block diagram, wind records, mooring and cable schematics. Increase rated power alone by 10%, retain capacity factor and recalculate annual energy. Baseline 23652 changes to 26017.2 MWh/year. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
